description: A minibus in side view has a long rounded roof, a sloping front windscreen, and two circular wheels. A horizontal window band is divided into panes, with a vertical door seam behind the front wheel.
An upright mug has a broad oval opening above tall sides that curve into a flat bottom. A large rounded handle joins the right side near the rim and lower body.
A mosquito seen from above has a round head, small thorax, and long pointed abdomen. Two broad wings spread diagonally outward, with angular legs extending above and below the body.
A bicycle in side view has two large circular wheels joined by an angular frame. A short saddle rises above the rear wheel, while the front fork connects to a curved handlebar.
A single broad hill rises from a straight horizontal base into a smooth rounded summit. Its sloping sides spread outward evenly and curve gently where they meet the lower corners.
A fish faces right with an oval body tapering toward its pointed head and forked tail. A curved gill line marks the face, and small fins project above and below the body.
A large circular lens is outlined by a thin round rim. A cord begins at the lower right edge, curves outward, and hangs vertically well below the bottom of the lens.
A small mink faces right with a long low body and an upright neck ending in a tapered muzzle. A dot marks the eye, two bent legs support it, and a short tail extends left.
A tall remote control has rounded corners and a horizontal division across its middle. Circular buttons occupy both sections, beside a long vertical rocker below and a short horizontal mark above.
A tall smartphone has rounded outer corners and a large blank screen between narrow top and bottom bands. A small circular home button sits at the center of the lower band.
A tapered roof panel contains three columns of curved tiles. Vertical seams run down the slope, while repeated arched edges divide the rows and form a scalloped lower edge.
A moose faces right with a long level back and two thick legs ending in rounded feet. Its large drooping muzzle sits below a broad antler with several rounded upward tines.
A sheep faces left with a scalloped woolly body supported by two short legs. Its rounded head projects forward, a curved ear droops beside the face, and a small dot marks the eye.
An upright mug has a straight open top, tall sides, and a deeply rounded bottom. A rounded handle projects to the right, while two short wavy steam trails rise separately above the rim.
A broad outlined ribbon bends into a rounded crest on the left and a rounded trough on the right. Its diagonal rising ends terminate in flat edges, creating a continuous flowing wave.
Three pointed mint leaves fan from one short upright stem, with the largest leaf in the center. Small serrations interrupt their edges, and branching veins extend from the shared central junction.
A roof panel widens toward its flat lower edge and has rounded outer corners. Overlapping rows of curved shingles fill the panel, with their vertical joins staggered between adjacent rows.
A tall milk can has a rounded rectangular body, sloped shoulders, and a narrow neck beneath a domed lid. Short handles angle upward from both shoulders beside the horizontal upper body seam.
A tapered windmill tower stands on a short baseline with a narrow doorway below. Four broad rectangular sails spread diagonally around the upper crossing, overlapping the pointed top of the tower.
Two triangular mountain peaks share a flat baseline, with the taller mountain on the left. A zigzag snow boundary crosses its upper slope, and a diagonal ridge descends toward the foreground.
Two rounded bust silhouettes overlap, with the larger figure in front on the right. Each has a circular head flowing into sloping shoulders and a broad curved lower edge without facial marks.
Two wide open chevrons face one another along a vertical axis. The upper chevron points downward and the lower one upward, with a clear gap between their tips and no shafts.
An upper downward chevron and a lower upward chevron mirror one another around an open central gap. Each consists of two long diagonal arms, with the outer ends spread widely apart.
A rounded capsule microphone stands upright on a thin vertical stem and short horizontal foot. Three pairs of grille lines extend inward from the sides, leaving an open strip through the center.
A semicircular watermelon slice tilts diagonally upward to the right. A curved inner line separates the broad rind from the flesh, where three small seed marks sit near the straight cut edge.
A broad rounded rectangle is divided by one vertical wavy line running from its top edge to its bottom. The alternating curves leave two blank compartments on either side of the membrane.
A mound of whipped cream rises from a broad rounded base through several bulging tiers. The outline narrows unevenly upward into a tall curved point that bends slightly to the left.
A low modem has a long horizontal body with rounded ends and no visible controls. One slim vertical antenna rises from its top near the right side, extending well above the base.
Three horizontal rounded bars share a common left edge beside a separate vertical guide. The upper bar is longest, the middle shorter, and the lower shortest, with even spaces between them.
An observatory has a rectangular base beneath a broad horizontal band and a large domed roof. A short telescope tube projects diagonally upward to the right, ending in a rounded outer collar.
A nightstand has a broad rounded tabletop above a rectangular cabinet and two short legs. A circular knob marks the upper drawer, with a horizontal division above the plain lower compartment.
A round nerve cell sits above a long descending axon that branches into curved terminals. Short straight dendrites radiate around the cell body, spreading upward and outward in several directions.
A bird faces left while sitting inside a deep curved nest. Its small pointed beak, dot eye, rounded head, and raised tail stand above the rim, while layered arcs cross the nest below.
A round cookie has a large scalloped bite missing from its upper right edge. Three small circular chips are spaced across the remaining face, surrounded by a broad unmarked curved rim.
An upright blank sheet has softly rounded lower corners and a folded upper right corner. The triangular fold turns inward above the open face, with a short curved join at its inner corner.
A broad cheese block has rounded corners and three circular holes of different sizes. Two cutouts open through its right edge, one long and rounded above a smaller curved notch near the base.
A deep bowl on a short foot holds a rounded heap of oatmeal rising above its straight rim. A long spoon handle tilts upward to the right from behind the food.
Six rounded grapes form a tapering bunch, with three across the top and one at the bottom. A short curved stem rises from the center and carries one pointed leaf leaning right.
A broad mustache has two rounded lobes meeting at a shallow upper notch. Its lower curves rise into a central point, while both outer tips curl upward into small pointed ends.
A central circular node connects to three surrounding circles with straight spokes. One node sits directly above it, while the other two spread diagonally down and outward on either side.
A narwhal swims diagonally upward to the right with a rounded body and a long pointed tusk. A small dot eye sits above its curved flipper, and two tail lobes spread behind it.
A simple house has a steep pitched roof, straight side walls, and a rounded doorway. A jagged crack descends from the right roof slope into the otherwise blank upper wall.
A speedometer has a broad arched dial above a flat base with rounded corners. Short ticks follow the upper curve, and a needle extends diagonally right from a small circular central hub.

Two large downward arrowheads stack vertically, with the upper triangle overlapping the top of the lower one. Their broad horizontal shoulders narrow into slightly rounded tips along a shared central axis.
One upright egg rises from a deep nest with a curved oval opening. The nest wraps around its lower half, with a horizontal rim band and a broad rounded underside.

An irregular upright crystal tapers into sharp points at its top and bottom. Angular internal seams divide the mineral into several long facets, with an interrupted contour along the upper right edge.
A cat head has two tall pointed ears, rounded cheeks, and two forehead stripes. Curved closed eyes sit above a small triangular nose, with a smiling muzzle and an open curved mouth below.
A front-facing hooded figure has a blank skull-shaped face enclosed by a broad rounded hood. The hood narrows into a point above sloping shoulders, with a vertical garment opening descending below.
Two wide horizontal rectangular bars sit one above the other with an open gap between them. A vertical guide passes through their shared center and extends beyond both outer edges.

A broad horizontal rounded block overlaps the middle of a tall vertical rounded block. The upright block remains visible above and below, creating a balanced cross-shaped silhouette with a clear foreground band.
A human head faces left with a short projecting nose, flat chin, and long neck. A rounded lobed brain sits within the upper skull, with a small downward extension at its rear.
A head faces right with a rounded skull, a projecting forehead, and an angular lower face. The upper interior contains a lobed brain with curved folds and a narrow descending stem.
The rounded lower half of a blank face sits above a long narrow neck. Both neck edges curve outward into sloping shoulders, while the upper face and lower torso remain open.
A long curved bridge descends from the upper left into a rounded nose tip. A shorter curve outlines the right nostril, and a separate shallow central curve joins the lower nasal contours.
A front-facing nose has a tall rounded bridge that widens into two bulbous nostrils. Short inward curves define the nostril openings around a rounded central tip along the lower edge.
A large spiral curves downward toward a small house at the lower right. The house has a peaked roof and rounded doorway, with the sweeping outer storm curve reaching left above it.

A large circle overlaps the upper left portion of a smaller rounded square. Both outlines remain visible through the shared region, creating curved and straight boundaries inside the lower right overlap.
Three rounded horizontal bars are stacked with even vertical gaps and a common left edge. Each bar is shorter than the one above it, creating a stepped outline on the right.
A broad outlined arrow bends from the lower right into a horizontal shaft pointing left. Its angular arrowhead opens around the shaft, while the trailing curve narrows toward the lower right tip.
A reader peers over an open book with two broad pages meeting at a central spine. Round hands grip the outer edges, beneath short eyes and curved hair lines across the forehead.
A front-facing reader wears a rounded cap and a plain garment with a short central neckline. An open book spreads across the chest, its curved upper edges meeting at a central fold.
A front-facing figure wears a broad headscarf framing an oval blank face. The scarf rounds beneath the chin above sloping shoulders, while two long interior lines mark the sides of the torso.
A tall squeeze bottle has a rounded rectangular body and a short cylindrical collar. A narrow tapered nozzle rises from the center of the collar, ending in a small rounded tip.
A mosque facade has two tall rounded towers flanking a lower central wall. Slim spires rise from both towers, horizontal bands cross their upper sections, and a pointed arched entrance opens below.

Three straight horizontal lines stack vertically with equal spacing and matching lengths. The upper, middle, and lower strokes form an open menu symbol without an enclosing border or additional marks.
A kiosk has a broad signboard above a rectangular booth and small lower door. A wide inset display occupies the upper half, divided into panes with short horizontal marks inside.
An upright newspaper has a large rectangular picture panel above two columns of short text lines. A narrow folded layer runs down the right edge and curls into the rounded lower corner.
A sweeping outlined swoosh curves around a broad hooked left end and narrows into a long point at the upper right. The inner curve rises smoothly toward the shallow angled upper edge.
A rounded ninja head wears a broad mask with a horizontal eye opening containing two short slanted eyes. A band crosses the forehead, and two pointed tie ends project to the right.
A large lobed cloud cap spreads above a narrow vertical column with gently curved sides. The column widens toward a low rounded base, forming a tall mushroom-shaped explosion silhouette.
A slender upright stem carries four long pointed leaves alternating to either side and at the top. Each leaf has a broad curved body tapering into a sharp tip without interior veins.
A long oboe runs diagonally from a flared lower left bell toward a narrow upper right mouthpiece. Three small tone-hole marks follow the slim body, which ends in a short projecting reed.
An open laptop has a broad blank screen with rounded upper corners. Its lower edge joins a shallow base that slopes outward toward two rounded front corners and a straight horizontal front edge.

A circle at the upper left overlaps a rounded square shifted down and right. The circle and square have similar overall widths, and both continuous outlines remain visible across their shared interior.
A rounded peach narrows into a small point at its base beneath a short curved stem. One pointed leaf extends left, and a long curved crease descends from the top into the fruit.
A cropped person has a circular head and one arm extending diagonally toward an open newspaper. The elbow bends into a rounded hand beneath two tilted pages joined along a central fold.
A human head faces right with a rounded crown and an angular nose and chin. A horizontal headband crosses the forehead, with one long pointed feather hanging behind the left side.
A long upright nail has a broad rounded horizontal head above a narrow straight shaft. The shaft continues down into an elongated pointed tip, with the head centered across its upper end.
An upright necktie has a broad trapezoid knot above a long tapered body. The body widens toward its lower section and then narrows into a centered pointed tip at the bottom.
A single circular outline is crossed by one straight diagonal slash rising from the lower left to the upper right. The slash meets the circle at both ends and divides its blank interior.

Three horizontal rounded bars share a common right edge with wide gaps between them. The top bar is longest, the middle bar starts farther right, and the shortest lower bar completes the stepped arrangement.
A long straight horizontal shaft points to the right, ending where two diagonal branches meet. The open arrowhead spreads widely above and below the shaft, without an outline enclosing its interior.
Two rounded horizontal bars of different lengths align along their right ends. Separate horizontal guide lines frame the arrangement above and below, with the lower bar shorter than the upper one.
A round sports ball has two tall curving seams sweeping from top to bottom. A third curved seam crosses them diagonally, dividing the circular surface into several broad asymmetric panels.
A plain square outline has four broad rounded corners and straight horizontal and vertical sides. Its interior is completely open, without an inset border, central mark, or other dividing lines.

Four matching small nanobots form a two-by-two arrangement. Each has a hexagonal body with a circular center, two curved side appendages, and one short straight appendage descending from its lower point.
A round disco ball has a grid of horizontal lines crossed by two curved vertical seams. Short rays radiate around its perimeter, with a longer vertical stroke rising directly above the top.
A dog head faces forward with a broad flat crown and rounded lower face. Two large floppy ears hang from the upper sides, framing a blank interior without eyes or muzzle markings.
A sleeveless nightgown has a broad rounded neckline between two short shoulder straps. Its sides curve inward near the chest and flare toward a wide gently curved hem at the bottom.
A table lamp has a tall shade with a domed top and gently sloping sides ending at a flat rim. A short rectangular stem joins it to a low rounded base.
A single upright oar has a broad blade with rounded upper corners and sides that taper into a pointed shoulder. A long straight shaft extends downward from the center of the blade.
A single upright oak leaf has rounded lobes arranged along both sides of a central vein. The top lobe is tall and domed, while the lower outline tapers into a short straight stem.
A slip dress hangs from two thin upright straps above a curved V-shaped neckline. Its fitted sides narrow at the waist and then flare outward toward a broad gently curved lower hem.
A muskrat faces left with a rounded hunched body, short muzzle, and small round ear. Bent legs tuck beneath its belly, while a long tail curves around the right side and trails below.
A small songbird faces right with a rounded head, pointed beak, and broad curved breast. A long tail extends down and left, while a curved wing and two thin bent legs complete the body.

A tall notebook has rounded corners and four short binding strokes crossing its left edge. Three horizontal lines sit on the otherwise blank cover, with the lower line slightly shorter than the others.
A sheep faces right with a long scalloped woolly back and a large rounded muzzle. Two slender legs descend from its body, beneath a small ear and a dot eye on the head.
A muscular arm bends upward from a low left elbow toward a rounded fist above. A curved bicep rises on the right, with short interior curves separating the forearm and upper arm.
A bent muscular arm raises a rounded fist near the top left, with the elbow bulging at the right. Curved interior lines define the bicep, forearm junction, and lower upper-arm contour.
Three circular nodes sit at the ends of a Y-shaped connector. One node is directly above the central junction, while the other two spread diagonally toward the lower left and lower right.
